name: Vikas Proppant & Granite Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Vikas Proppant & Granite Ltd is in the business of mining of Granite Blocks and manufacturing of Proppants.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
VPGL was in the business of guar gum and then shifted towards oil fracturing proppants by making use of cuttings (waste materials) of granite stones. Currently, it is diversifying its business into the Real Estate Sector, Construction Sector and setting up industry as well. This new division is planned to expand its business more constructively and smartly, such as construction of group housing projects under Mukhya Mantri Awas Yojna & Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana at Pan India level, Govt tenders for multilevel infrastructure developments, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.09 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.21% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Company has high debtors of 2,652 days.
